8dc5afd2fa9e.t: Final Homeegg sengit, begitu juga permainan Maiara. Maiara menjaringkan gol; Eori masih bosan. Orang ramai bersorak ketika perlawanan diteruskan, dan Eori pergi membeli sesuatu.

914596199232.en: Arukia uses a body as a meat shield; two dying Cruros share the other bandit as theirs; four agents run toward them
914596199232.t: Arukia menggunakan sebuah badan sebagai perisai daging; dua Cruro yang nazak berkongsi penyamun yang lagi seorang sebagai perisai mereka; empat ejen berlari ke arah mereka

9286227aa2b8.en: Hanako: "Damn. All right, fine. We know Desmond fought with someone after leaving the atelier, then took off running toward a guard post. That's all we know. We used the money he gave us to pay for town-crier calls for him. Now you need to get out if you're not going to buy something. Yosuke helped pay the town crier, but he's clamping down harder on us."
9286227aa2b8.t: Hanako: “Celaka. Okey, baiklah. Kami tahu Desmond bergaduh dengan seseorang selepas tinggalkan atelier, kemudian lari ke arah pondok pengawal. Itu saja yang kami tahu. Kami guna duit yang dia bagi untuk bayar pelaung bandar memanggil dia. Sekarang korang kena keluar kalau tak nak beli apa-apa. Yosuke tolong bayar pelaung bandar, tapi dia makin ketat dengan kami.”

93567d3f122b.en: She also gets a letter from Coema: stop being a little bitch, and think for yourself for once. Neferteri will only stop controlling you when she realizes you're a lost cause. Rebel, throw a temper tantrum, have fun! If you need some investment for that, get in touch, but be sure to follow through, or I'll be worse than Neferteri.
93567d3f122b.t: Dia juga menerima surat daripada Coema: berhenti jadi jalang kecil, dan fikir sendiri buat sekali ini. Neferteri hanya akan berhenti mengawal kau bila dia sedar kau dah tak boleh diharap. Memberontak, mengamuk, berseronok! Kalau kau perlukan modal untuk tu, hubungi aku, tapi pastikan kau laksanakan, atau aku akan lebih teruk daripada Neferteri.

936db2f1db3f.en: Eori pulls out the arrow and presses her hand over the hole. "You don't have to be so fucking jumpy, you know." Magi, feeling the weight of the conspiracy, nocks another arrow. "So you made Harry disappear?" "Why would I be here, then?" Magi draws further. "To keep me from spreading the word that you were having—intimate relations with a commoner." "I cared about that at one point. Now I just want Harry back. You gonna stand there all day, or are you gonna heal me?"
936db2f1db3f.t: Eori mencabut anak panah itu dan menekan tangannya pada lubang itu. “Kau tak perlu melatah sangat, kau tahu.” Magi, merasakan beratnya konspirasi itu, memasang satu lagi anak panah. “Jadi kau yang buat Harry hilang?” “Kalau macam tu kenapa aku di sini?” Magi menarik lebih jauh. “Untuk halang aku sebarkan berita yang kau ada—hubungan intim dengan rakyat biasa.” “Aku pernah peduli pasal tu. Sekarang aku cuma nak Harry balik. Kau nak berdiri di situ sepanjang hari, atau kau nak sembuhkan aku?”

948b6c49b632.en: Morika has a prod heating in the fire. Arukia is chained up, with stab wounds in her belly. Morika gets ready to stab again, but Neferteri raises a hand to stop him; Morika holds back and carefully places the prod back in the fire.
948b6c49b632.t: Morika memanaskan sebatang besi pencucuk dalam api. Arukia dirantai, dengan luka tikaman di perutnya. Morika bersedia untuk menikam lagi, tetapi Neferteri mengangkat tangan untuk menghentikannya; Morika menahan diri dan dengan berhati-hati meletakkan pencucuk itu semula ke dalam api.

949fc832a91a.en: Arukia walks out, remembering doing something like this before. She takes off running, and the people following her do the same. She runs as if in desperation, but toward a predetermined spot.
949fc832a91a.t: Arukia keluar, teringat pernah melakukan sesuatu seperti ini sebelum ini. Dia memecut lari, dan orang yang mengekorinya berbuat sama. Dia berlari seolah-olah terdesak, tetapi menuju ke tempat yang sudah ditetapkan.

94b122f4861b.en: She can't even face her own parents, if they're even still alive after what she did to the Red Winga. She knew where they were and what the Red Winga could do, but she still went through with it, and fled it all. She hoes even harder, and then hears a cry.
94b122f4861b.t: Dia tidak sanggup pun berdepan dengan ibu bapanya sendiri, jika mereka masih hidup selepas apa yang dia buat kepada Red Winga. Dia tahu di mana mereka dan apa yang Red Winga mampu buat, tetapi dia tetap meneruskannya, dan lari daripada semuanya. Dia mencangkul lebih kuat, kemudian terdengar tangisan.

96f83aca6d2a.en: Magi and Eori make their way back to Sanbi
96f83aca6d2a.t: Magi dan Eori dalam perjalanan kembali ke Sanbi

972bc58545e9.t: Arukia menemui seekor Bruntos yang cedera

97648d9eb19b.en: Arukia: Someone was calling my name, and now this? Does Eori want Harry back this badly? Could this be my ticket out of the Red Winga? She grabs her money pouch: she can either buy a nari gel to stay on the island, or use the money to go back to Sanbi. She looks at her baby, then at her ragged clothes. They leave without buying anything.
97648d9eb19b.t: Arukia: Ada orang panggil nama aku, dan sekarang ni? Eori nak Harry balik sampai macam ni sekali ke? Mungkinkah ini tiket aku keluar dari Red Winga? Dia mencapai kantung wangnya: dia boleh sama ada membeli nari gel untuk terus tinggal di pulau itu, atau menggunakan wang itu untuk kembali ke Sanbi. Dia memandang bayinya, kemudian pakaiannya yang compang-camping. Mereka beredar tanpa membeli apa-apa.

97755385fee5.en: Yosuke bangs his metal ladle on something to wake everyone. He bonks Dalila on the head to get her up; Harry looks at the open window.
97755385fee5.t: Yosuke mengetuk senduk logamnya pada sesuatu untuk membangunkan semua orang. Dia mengetuk kepala Dalila untuk membangunkannya; Harry memandang tingkap yang terbuka.

97f7287d83b2.en: She thinks about things: her life, her father, and so on. Then Harry appears in her mind. She wakes up, trying to clear her head, but his smile when he invited her in keeps nagging at her. Then Morika, and Eori. Did Eori really love some random guy from the Sanbi slums?
97f7287d83b2.t: Dia memikirkan banyak perkara: hidupnya, ayahnya, dan sebagainya. Kemudian Harry muncul dalam fikirannya. Dia terjaga, cuba menjernihkan fikiran, tetapi senyuman Harry ketika mengajaknya masuk terus mengganggunya. Kemudian Morika, dan Eori. Adakah Eori betul-betul mencintai seorang lelaki entah siapa dari setinggan Sanbi?

9829c5ad9c27.en: Magi sees how many balls are in it. "What do you want from me?" "Help—me find Harry. You know what he looks like." Magi eyes the inviting bag. "P—post a quest, and we'll talk about it!" "I can't fucking do that! Mom will realize what I'm trying to do!" "Mom? You mean the queen of Sanbi?" "Who else, you dumb bitch? I'm trying to break free of her grip! I'm sick of this shit!" Magi: "All right. Fine. Let's go back to the restaurant. Just remember, he was called Desmond."
9829c5ad9c27.t: Magi nampak berapa banyak bola di dalamnya. “Apa kau nak daripada aku?” “Tolong—aku cari Harry. Kau tahu rupa dia.” Magi merenung beg yang menggoda itu. “L—letak misi, dan kita bincang!” “Aku tak boleh buat macam tu, celaka! Mak akan sedar apa aku cuba buat!” “Mak? Maksud kau permaisuri Sanbi?” “Siapa lagi, kau jalang bodoh? Aku cuba nak lepas daripada cengkaman dia! Aku dah muak dengan semua karut ni!” Magi: “Okey. Baiklah. Jom balik ke restoran. Cuma ingat, dia dipanggil Desmond.”

99c5a4cdaecf.en: Coema plans an assault to rescue Harry and Arukia. She sends word to Eiri and Sora to declare Eori missing and call an emergency meeting, while the rest of them split up to get both Harry and Arukia out, and imprison Neferteri.
99c5a4cdaecf.t: Coema merancang serangan untuk menyelamatkan Harry dan Arukia. Dia menghantar pesanan kepada Eiri dan Sora untuk mengisytiharkan Eori hilang dan memanggil mesyuarat kecemasan, sementara yang lain berpecah untuk mengeluarkan Harry dan Arukia, dan memenjarakan Neferteri.

99f95311890c.en: A whack to the back of the neck drops one of the bandits forward, and soon after, the other. A Cruro gives a thumbs-up with a small grunt, but then another Cruro squeals in pain: an arrow has perforated its lung. They turn, but can't see anything. Arukia leaps forward and uses one of the bodies as a shield.
99f95311890c.t: Satu pukulan di belakang tengkuk menjatuhkan salah seorang penyamun ke depan, dan tidak lama kemudian, yang seorang lagi. Seorang Cruro mengangkat ibu jari dengan dengusan kecil, tetapi kemudian seorang lagi Cruro mencicit kesakitan: sebatang anak panah telah menembusi paru-parunya. Mereka berpaling, tetapi tidak nampak apa-apa. Arukia melompat ke depan dan menggunakan salah satu badan sebagai perisai.

9a7bc8950aec.en: She bows and starts off, then weighs her green bag, opens it and peeks inside: several small Fost stones, about the size of a piece of gum. She turns around. "Did I drop some, by any chance?" The older lady looks away. "I'm sure they're all there, sweetie." Then she looks back. "Unless… are you saying we're bandits?" Magi feels an ominous presence from them. Someone at the back: "What do you say? Let's call it a rescue fee?"
9a7bc8950aec.t: Dia menunduk hormat dan mula berjalan, kemudian menimbang beg hijaunya, membukanya dan mengintai ke dalam: beberapa Fost stone kecil, lebih kurang sebesar sekeping gula-gula getah. Dia berpaling. “Ada saya tercicir beberapa, kebetulan?” Wanita tua itu memandang ke arah lain. “Mak cik pasti semuanya ada di situ, sayang.” Kemudian dia memandang balik. “Melainkan… kau kata kami penyamun?” Magi merasakan kehadiran yang menyeramkan daripada mereka. Seseorang di belakang: “Macam mana? Kita panggil yuran menyelamat?”

9b3e5db85e30.en: Magi looks at the gore, gets irritated and breaks out of her shell. "Why don't we just capture him instead?" Eori: "Morika would never talk. He's her perfect pawn, blindly following her around." Ryo eats his nari gel and starts transforming. "He's taking her away! Let's go." The others follow suit.
9b3e5db85e30.t: Magi memandang darah dan daging itu, menjadi jengkel dan keluar dari cengkerangnya. “Kenapa kita tak tangkap saja dia?” Eori: “Morika takkan bercakap. Dia bidak sempurna mak, mengikutnya membuta tuli.” Ryo makan nari gelnya dan mula berubah. “Dia bawa Arukia pergi! Jom.” Yang lain mengikut.

9bc357915d7b.en: An older lady scolds her as she hands over her things. "Lady! You need to be more careful! There are bandits around!" The girl in pink takes her bow, attaches it to her backpack and puts it on. "I'm sorry!"
9bc357915d7b.t: Seorang wanita tua memarahinya ketika menyerahkan barangnya. “Cik! Kau kena lebih berhati-hati! Ada penyamun di sekitar sini!” Gadis berbaju merah jambu itu mengambil busurnya, menyangkutnya pada beg galas dan memakainya. “Maaf!”

a068e9eca10a.en: His hand freezes. "Morika Tolerideme. An adventurer protecting Princess Eori." Eori, now on Magi's side: "What the fuck are you doing here?" Morika slowly takes out his badge. "You're an invaluable target for kidnapping." Eori looks at the lit-up badge, clearly saying Morika. "Oh! So you're gonna kidnap me instead?" She remembers being kidnapped by Namia and Posaqui. "You know what? You can all go fuck yourselves. I'm not her little bitch anymore!" She walks off, away from Morika.
a068e9eca10a.t: Tangannya kaku. “Morika Tolerideme. Pengembara yang melindungi Puteri Eori.” Eori, kini di pihak Magi: “Apa celaka kau buat di sini?” Morika perlahan-lahan mengeluarkan lencananya. “Tuan puteri sasaran penculikan yang tidak ternilai.” Eori memandang lencana yang menyala, jelas tertulis Morika. “Oh! Jadi kau pula nak culik aku?” Dia teringat diculik oleh Namia dan Posaqui. “Kau tahu apa? Korang semua boleh pergi mampus. Aku bukan jalang kecil dia lagi!” Dia berjalan pergi, menjauhi Morika.

a0ba6b72fc70.en: The clerk hands her about 2 Pearls; Magi asleep in a seat with her backpack and bow
a0ba6b72fc70.t: Kerani menyerahkan lebih kurang 2 Pearl kepadanya; Magi tertidur di kerusi dengan beg galas dan busurnya

a0e663a3037c.en: Desmond leans back. "You okay? You just passed out cold." Magi glares at him. "Don't touch me!" "DESMOND! STOP FLIRTING AND CLEAN THIS SHIT UP!" Rimir's scream from the kitchen door breaks the awkwardness filling the room. "Sorry, pink adventurer. I'll grab you another drink. You can stay here until I finish cleaning up the floor."
a0e663a3037c.t: Desmond bersandar ke belakang. “Kau okey? Kau tiba-tiba pengsan.” Magi menjelingnya. “Jangan sentuh aku!” “DESMOND! BERHENTI MENGURAT DAN BERSIHKAN TAIK NI!” Jeritan Rimir dari pintu dapur memecahkan kejanggalan yang memenuhi bilik. “Maaf, pengembara merah jambu. Aku ambilkan kau minuman lain. Kau boleh tunggu di sini sampai aku habis bersihkan lantai.”

a16e52fefa20.en: As Eori walks away, Morika glances at her, puts his badge away, and looks at Harry, looking pretty dead, and at Magi, frozen, not quite getting how a princess could say something like that. He takes out a pouch of balls and tosses it at Harry's feet. "Apologies for Princess Eori's behavior. She mistook you for someone she knew."
a16e52fefa20.t: Ketika Eori berjalan pergi, Morika mengerlingnya, menyimpan lencananya, dan memandang Harry, yang nampak hampir mati, dan Magi, kaku, tidak begitu faham bagaimana seorang puteri boleh berkata begitu. Dia mengeluarkan sekantung bola dan mencampaknya ke kaki Harry. “Maafkan kelakuan Puteri Eori. Dia tersalah sangka kau orang yang dikenalinya.”

a2e87f72ca6e.en: On the wagon, Magi falls asleep on Eori's shoulder, and Eori slaps her awake. That drives them further apart, since Magi hides that she has narcolepsy.
a2e87f72ca6e.t: Di atas gerabak, Magi tertidur di bahu Eori, dan Eori menamparnya hingga terjaga. Itu menjauhkan mereka lagi, kerana Magi menyembunyikan bahawa dia menghidap narkolepsi.

a331c4fa1d66.en: Magi, nervous, at the corner, watching the building; the door is closed, but there's still light inside
a331c4fa1d66.t: Magi, gugup, di sudut jalan, memerhati bangunan itu; pintu tertutup, tetapi masih ada cahaya di dalam

a36da4310d64.en: Magi at the Embassy at the crack of dawn; the clerk has a copy of the badge
a36da4310d64.t: Magi di Kedutaan awal subuh; kerani ada salinan lencana itu

a475e6d40d1f.en: She goes downstairs to search for Harry, but only finds Arukia's body against the wall. Her anger builds toward Arukia for everything she did to Harry, and to her. She drags the body downstairs, adds more nari gel, and tries to revive her. Nothing. Eori punches Arukia in the chest, breaking her ribs, and keeps punching as tears stream from her eyes.
a475e6d40d1f.t: Dia turun ke bawah untuk mencari Harry, tetapi hanya menemui mayat Arukia bersandar di dinding. Kemarahannya terhadap Arukia memuncak kerana semua yang dilakukannya kepada Harry, dan kepadanya. Dia mengheret mayat itu ke bawah, menambah lagi nari gel, dan cuba menghidupkannya semula. Tiada apa-apa. Eori menumbuk dada Arukia, mematahkan rusuknya, dan terus menumbuk ketika air mata mengalir dari matanya.

a67df01aa37b.en: They realize Harry must be alive somewhere, and they need to talk with Coema to find out where. Sora argues it's pointless: the search quest never did anything, and Coema hasn't found Arukia yet. Eiri: "We must try! Can you imagine what Harry went through after he was kidnapped, right after starting his job as the Sanbi Eye?"
a67df01aa37b.t: Mereka sedar Harry mesti masih hidup di suatu tempat, dan mereka perlu bercakap dengan Coema untuk tahu di mana. Sora berhujah ia sia-sia: misi pencarian tidak pernah menghasilkan apa-apa, dan Coema belum menemui Arukia. Eiri: “Kita mesti cuba! Kau boleh bayangkan apa yang Harry lalui selepas dia diculik, sebaik mula kerja sebagai Sanbi Eye?”

a75bb553a801.en: A construction guy walks in, looking turned on. Ryo laughs. "Damn! This place is gonna do nicely. How can I help ya?" "We're finishing prepping the walls. Have you decided on the color scheme?" "Crap, I forgot to ask you about that." Katsumi decides on a name on the spot, {WIP-katsumiWhorehouse}, plus the color scheme. Ryo: "There's your answer."
a75bb553a801.t: Seorang pekerja binaan masuk, nampak terangsang. Ryo ketawa. “Celaka! Tempat ni akan maju. Apa aku boleh bantu?” “Kami tengah siapkan dinding. Tuan dah putuskan skema warna?” “Alamak, aku lupa nak tanya kau pasal tu.” Katsumi memutuskan nama di situ juga, {WIP-katsumiWhorehouse}, serta skema warnanya. Ryo: “Itulah jawapan kau.”

a8bf0e507072.en: Looking at herself in the mirror, it dawns on her that Harry is still out there. She could have gotten some information out of that fake Harry about where he found a Harry-based nari gel, but she was too angry to think of it. She breaks something in anger, which makes her even more furious. "Now I have to go through every single nari gel vendor to find out where it was made…"
a8bf0e507072.t: Memandang dirinya di cermin, barulah dia sedar Harry masih ada di luar sana. Dia boleh dapatkan sedikit maklumat daripada Harry palsu itu tentang di mana dia menemui nari gel berasaskan Harry, tetapi dia terlalu marah untuk terfikir. Dia memecahkan sesuatu kerana marah, yang membuatnya lebih berang. “Sekarang aku kena periksa setiap penjual nari gel untuk tahu di mana ia dibuat…”

a981aa55fb02.en: Harry helps them set up shop while Dalila, Yosuke and Rimir cook; Magi somewhere in the background
a981aa55fb02.t: Harry membantu mereka menyediakan gerai sementara Dalila, Yosuke dan Rimir memasak; Magi di suatu tempat di belakang

aa2c38b26298.en: She'll use something to test his soul, and see that it doesn't work. She'll refuse to believe it, while the people around her use it as proof that she's misbehaving, and let Harry go free.
aa2c38b26298.t: Dia akan menggunakan sesuatu untuk menguji jiwanya, dan melihat ia tidak berfungsi. Dia akan enggan mempercayainya, sementara orang di sekelilingnya menggunakannya sebagai bukti bahawa dia berkelakuan buruk, dan melepaskan Harry.

aabc0163f230.en: Eori, her appearance changed with nari gels, in a cheap room
aabc0163f230.t: Eori, rupanya diubah dengan nari gel, di sebuah bilik murah

aafa005e528f.en: Eiri: "So what do I do? Should I talk to Itagiba?" Coema shoves a snack in her mouth. "No. He'll get drunk and say something that gives us away. You two stay in the dark until Eori wreaks havoc." "Eori? But she's in Forway." "Not for long. She'll show up back in Sanbi any time now." "How do you know?" "Just as you and Sora saw those Harry-feller nari gels, Eori must have seen them too."
aafa005e528f.t: Eiri: “Jadi apa aku patut buat? Patutkah aku bercakap dengan Itagiba?” Coema menyumbat snek ke dalam mulutnya. “Tak. Dia akan mabuk dan cakap sesuatu yang membongkar kita. Korang berdua kekal dalam gelap sampai Eori buat huru-hara.” “Eori? Tapi dia di Forway.” “Tak lama lagi. Dia akan muncul balik di Sanbi bila-bila masa saja.” “Macam mana kau tahu?” “Sama macam kau dan Sora nampak nari gel si Harry tu, Eori pun mesti dah nampak.”

ad2f464ec672.en: The next morning, Magi stands in front of The Wood People Picker
ad2f464ec672.t: Pagi esoknya, Magi berdiri di depan The Wood People Picker

ae56032acc3c.en: "Going to sign another? I have a few." Magi: "Whatever's safest, for the most money." "More roadwork, I presume?" Magi nods, holding the two Pearls. She pulls out her badge, makes it light up, and hands the two Pearls back. "Can you please add these to the Blue-Flower-Red-Bone guild?" The clerk doesn't take them. Instead, he smiles. "I'll get the contracts arranged. Please excuse me."
ae56032acc3c.t: “Nak tandatangan lagi? Saya ada beberapa.” Magi: “Apa saja yang paling selamat, untuk wang paling banyak.” “Kerja jalan raya lagi, saya agak?” Magi mengangguk, memegang dua Pearl itu. Dia mengeluarkan lencananya, membuatnya menyala, dan menyerahkan semula dua Pearl itu. “Boleh tolong tambah ini ke persatuan Blue-Flower-Red-Bone?” Kerani tidak mengambilnya. Sebaliknya, dia tersenyum. “Saya akan uruskan kontrak-kontrak itu. Maafkan saya sebentar.”

af7df03ae7ab.en: To Magi, Eori seems kind of controlling, and antisocial. She wonders if Harry running away from her was a sign that something bad happened between them.
af7df03ae7ab.t: Bagi Magi, Eori nampak agak suka mengawal, dan antisosial. Dia tertanya-tanya sama ada Harry melarikan diri daripadanya satu petanda sesuatu yang buruk berlaku antara mereka.

af8cf250a0df.en: Eori has an altercation with Morika, who has basically put her under house arrest
af8cf250a0df.t: Eori bertengkar dengan Morika, yang pada dasarnya meletakkannya di bawah tahanan rumah

b04499d5cbd7.en: Hanako clears her throat as she comes closer. "Then what are you doing in his room, drenched in sweat?" Magi looks at her damp clothes, and her face turns redder. "It's not what you're thinking! I passed out!" "Ohhhhhh—he's that good?" Magi stares back, not understanding.
b04499d5cbd7.t: Hanako berdehem sambil mendekat. “Habis apa kau buat dalam bilik dia, basah kuyup dengan peluh?” Magi memandang pakaiannya yang lembap, dan mukanya semakin merah. “Bukan macam yang kau fikir! Aku pengsan!” “Ohhhhhh—hebat sangat ke dia?” Magi merenung balik, tidak faham.

b24168a24ddd.en: Hanako and Mimi tell Magi to get fucked for not helping find Desmond. Magi says she's investigating what happened to him now. Hanako probes her, but she dodges.
b24168a24ddd.t: Hanako dan Mimi menyuruh Magi pergi mampus kerana tidak membantu mencari Desmond. Magi kata dia sedang menyiasat apa yang berlaku kepadanya sekarang. Hanako mengoreknya, tetapi dia mengelak.

b3011bcf594e.en: They leave. Magi asks what Eori's relationship with him is. Eori says they were lovers, fleeing Neferteri's grasp. Magi takes it in, but something doesn't feel right.
b3011bcf594e.t: Mereka beredar. Magi bertanya apa hubungan Eori dengannya. Eori kata mereka kekasih, lari daripada cengkaman Neferteri. Magi menerimanya, tetapi ada sesuatu yang terasa tak kena.

b4984983c636.en: The Cruros see how smart the idea is, but as they try it, another arrow hits them. Arukia, unarmed and at a dead end, desperately looks for a way out, when one of the Cruros dying on the ground coughs up blood. She sees he's carrying a small knife. "Give me his knife."
b4984983c636.t: Cruro-cruro itu nampak betapa bijaknya idea itu, tetapi ketika mereka mencubanya, sebatang lagi anak panah mengenai mereka. Arukia, tidak bersenjata dan terperangkap di jalan mati, terdesak mencari jalan keluar, apabila salah seorang Cruro yang nazak di tanah membatukkan darah. Dia nampak Cruro itu membawa sebilah pisau kecil. “Bagi aku pisau dia.”

b56bff2eb24b.en: Ryo is mesmerized by her ability to eat Barinas like no one else; Katsuki is so focused she doesn't even offer him any. "You like Barinas that much?" Katsuki, frog juice dripping down her chin, nods and keeps going.
b56bff2eb24b.t: Ryo terpukau dengan keupayaannya makan Barinas tidak seperti orang lain; Katsuki begitu fokus sehingga tidak menawarkannya pun. “Kau suka Barina sangat ke?” Katsuki, jus katak menitis di dagunya, mengangguk dan terus makan.

b62cd02e5b78.en: Ryo: "The Cruros. See how the share of Cruros in the bar is higher than out in the street?" Katsuki starts noticing it, and sure enough, once you pay attention, it looks like a Cruro festival is going on. Ryo: "Lesson of the day: you need to know people's tactics, and that lets you see what's going on without asking a single question. Granted, it's a bet, but I'm fairly sure who's behind this one. Follow me."
b62cd02e5b78.t: Ryo: “Cruro. Nampak tak bahagian Cruro dalam bar ni lebih tinggi berbanding di jalan?” Katsuki mula perasan, dan memang benar, sebaik kau beri perhatian, ia nampak seperti ada pesta Cruro sedang berlangsung. Ryo: “Pelajaran hari ni: kau perlu tahu taktik orang, dan itu membolehkan kau nampak apa yang berlaku tanpa bertanya satu soalan pun. Memang, ia pertaruhan, tapi aku agak pasti siapa di sebalik yang ni. Ikut aku.”

b64b3dc833f7.en: Eori: I can't believe she's taking that bitch's body to my house! Anger flares. She swoops in, crashing through a window on the upper floor. "Morika" (actually {WIP-morikaDecoy}) climbs the stairs.
b64b3dc833f7.t: Eori: Aku tak percaya dia bawa mayat jalang tu ke rumah aku! Kemarahan marak. Dia menjunam masuk, merempuh sebuah tingkap di tingkat atas. “Morika” (sebenarnya {WIP-morikaDecoy}) mendaki tangga.

b7a4bd08ee56.en: Magi startles awake, with no idea where she is, her head pounding. Her backpack and bow are missing, but searching frantically, she finds them right by the bed. Her clothes are damp, but the warmth of the bed makes her feel better.
b7a4bd08ee56.t: Magi tersentak bangun, tidak tahu di mana dia berada, kepalanya berdenyut. Beg galas dan busurnya hilang, tetapi mencari dengan panik, dia menemuinya betul-betul di tepi katil. Pakaiannya lembap, tetapi kehangatan katil membuatnya rasa lebih baik.

b7a824acd3ca.en: Assistant: "I heard all about it in the letter. You two are indeed quite cute. With that in mind, here's a gift I bought." She brings out a kimono-like outfit for each of them. Ryo: "Actually, I forgot to tell you: only Katsumi will be running this place. Katsuki wants to travel with me instead." "You want to travel with her instead. I know how this goes."
b7a824acd3ca.t: Pembantu: “Saya dah dengar semuanya dalam surat. Kamu berdua memang comel. Dengan itu, ini hadiah yang saya beli.” Dia mengeluarkan pakaian seperti kimono untuk setiap seorang. Ryo: “Sebenarnya, aku terlupa nak beritahu kau: hanya Katsumi yang akan uruskan tempat ni. Katsuki nak mengembara dengan aku.” “Tuan yang nak mengembara dengan dia. Saya tahu macam mana benda ni.”

b8b3d4594570.en: Tons of food are ready, and they celebrate. Yosuke tells them to rest well: the wagons arrive at Sunnalow to pick up the food, and they'd better be ready!
b8b3d4594570.t: Berlambak makanan sudah siap, dan mereka meraikan. Yosuke menyuruh mereka berehat secukupnya: gerabak tiba pada Sunnalow untuk mengambil makanan, dan baik mereka bersedia!

b8ca6ba0b6db.en: Magi, holding the key, looks at the dead Harry and gives him the last bit of Nari Refresher she has. Harry loses some weight as his body recovers, but the only change in his appearance is his hair turning black again.
b8ca6ba0b6db.t: Magi, memegang kunci itu, memandang Harry yang mati dan memberinya sisa terakhir Nari Refresher yang dimilikinya. Harry susut sedikit berat ketika badannya pulih, tetapi satu-satunya perubahan pada rupanya ialah rambutnya kembali hitam.

b9526b14c9a3.en: Harry eats a nari gel to improve his eyes. It hurts. Magi keeps to herself.
b9526b14c9a3.t: Harry makan nari gel untuk memperbaiki matanya. Sakit. Magi berdiam diri.

b96e4cff3c38.en: Arukia, hiding somewhere in Endlessfog, hoes in the sun. She stops for a second to watch a passing boat and wonders how long she's been here. Maybe it's for the better: no more Red Winga, no more Harry, no more anyone. Just her.
b96e4cff3c38.t: Arukia, bersembunyi di suatu tempat di Endlessfog, mencangkul di bawah matahari. Dia berhenti seketika untuk memerhati bot yang lalu dan tertanya-tanya sudah berapa lama dia di sini. Mungkin lebih baik begini: tiada lagi Red Winga, tiada lagi Harry, tiada lagi sesiapa. Hanya dia.

baf78203b00c.en: Coema: "Eori, you're not the only one looking for Harry." Ryo: "We all have our reasons, but we want to help him too." Tears well up in Eori's eyes. "Harry is mine! He was mine from the beginning!" Coema: "But does he want to be yours?"
baf78203b00c.t: Coema: “Eori, kau bukan seorang saja yang cari Harry.” Ryo: “Kami semua ada sebab sendiri, tapi kami nak tolong dia juga.” Air mata bergenang di mata Eori. “Harry aku punya! Dia aku punya dari awal!” Coema: “Tapi adakah dia nak jadi milik kau?”

bb4a6a5e5771.en: Her heart races thinking of all the money she'd get. Then she remembers something from back in Blood, when she applied to the guild to become a Pearl: she can borrow a suspect's badge for up to a week, but if she loses it, she pays ten times the price or is forced to work until the debt is paid off, plus other fees if she takes more than a week. (The Missing Person rule: only for adventurers investigating with a good lead.) She decides she'll do it.
bb4a6a5e5771.t: Jantungnya berdegup kencang memikirkan semua wang yang akan diperolehnya. Kemudian dia teringat sesuatu dari Blood dahulu, ketika dia memohon kepada persatuan untuk menjadi Pearl: dia boleh meminjam lencana suspek sehingga seminggu, tetapi jika dia kehilangannya, dia membayar sepuluh kali ganda harganya atau dipaksa bekerja sehingga hutang dibayar, ditambah yuran lain jika dia mengambil lebih daripada seminggu. (Peraturan Missing Person: hanya untuk pengembara yang menyiasat dengan petunjuk yang baik.) Dia memutuskan dia akan melakukannya.

bba0f92a584e.en: They're carrying something when they get hurt in a landslide. Arukia shields the baby Bruntos, but breaks her ribs, and more.
bba0f92a584e.t: Mereka sedang membawa sesuatu apabila tercedera dalam tanah runtuh. Arukia melindungi bayi Bruntos itu, tetapi rusuknya patah, dan lebih lagi.

bc7e2c1df249.en: A poke on her cheek wakes her: the same clerk, handing her a measly two Pearls. "Hey, miss. You didn't return all the stones." She holds out her hands and he places them there, then shows her the contract: she got more Fost stones from them than she brought back. Magi clutches the two Pearls to her chest, holding back her tears. The clerk waves the contract; she signs it.
bc7e2c1df249.t: Cucukan di pipinya membangunkannya: kerani yang sama, menyerahkan dua Pearl yang tidak seberapa. “Hei, cik. Cik tak pulangkan semua batu.” Dia menghulurkan tangan dan kerani meletakkannya di situ, kemudian menunjukkan kontrak: dia mengambil lebih banyak Fost stone daripada mereka berbanding yang dibawanya balik. Magi memeluk dua Pearl itu ke dadanya, menahan air mata. Kerani mengibas kontrak itu; dia menandatanganinya.

bcc7a0f5770c.en: Eiri: "We want to help him." "By doing what, exactly?" They don't know; Sora talks about asking around. Coema: "I'll take care of that. I have a better job for you two: feed Neferteri false information, and don't let her find out I'm behind Eori's escapade. Though I wouldn't be surprised if she's put two and two together."
bcc7a0f5770c.t: Eiri: “Kami nak tolong dia.” “Dengan buat apa, tepatnya?” Mereka tidak tahu; Sora bercakap tentang bertanya-tanya. Coema: “Aku uruskan tu. Aku ada kerja lebih baik untuk korang berdua: suap Neferteri dengan maklumat palsu, dan jangan biar dia tahu aku di sebalik pengembaraan Eori. Walaupun aku tak terkejut kalau dia dah dapat agak.”

beaab2781025.en: Arukia looks at Harry, then back at Neferteri. "Why are you trying to defend against Forway? The Prosperity Treaty exists for a reason." "Until it doesn't. It's a piece of paper, backed by the promises of men and women, which turn into backstabbing over the simplest arguments."
beaab2781025.t: Arukia memandang Harry, kemudian kembali kepada Neferteri. “Kenapa kau cuba bertahan menentang Forway? Perjanjian Kemakmuran wujud bersebab.” “Sehingga ia tidak lagi wujud. Ia sehelai kertas, disokong janji lelaki dan wanita, yang bertukar menjadi tikam belakang kerana pertengkaran yang paling remeh.”

beb263296a34.en: Her friend ({WIP-eoriRoommate}) comes into the room with tickets to Maiara's championship. Eori snaps at her, but the girl snaps right back, showing who's boss. They argue, and in the end the friend wins: Eori lets her win before she flips her shit and kills her on the spot.
beb263296a34.t: Kawannya ({WIP-eoriRoommate}) masuk ke bilik dengan tiket ke kejohanan Maiara. Eori membentaknya, tetapi gadis itu membentak balik, menunjukkan siapa bos. Mereka bertengkar, dan akhirnya kawannya menang: Eori membiarkannya menang sebelum dia hilang akal dan membunuhnya di situ juga.

bee0b5c43fdf.en: Chapter 1 - If only I had Bagarisa Power
bee0b5c43fdf.t: Bab 1 - Kalaulah Aku Ada Kuasa Bagarisa

bf2cfed8a03e.en: Arukia is about to pass out when he suddenly goes limp and falls forward, hitting his head next to hers. She gasps and pushes the dead body aside. Four more Cruros appear to help her, looking battered from a fight.
bf2cfed8a03e.t: Arukia hampir pengsan apabila lelaki itu tiba-tiba longlai dan jatuh ke depan, kepalanya terhentak di sebelah kepala Arukia. Dia tercungap dan menolak mayat itu ke tepi. Empat lagi Cruro muncul untuk membantunya, nampak lebam selepas bertarung.

bf7f37100674.en: "My Queen! I have urgent news!" someone calls from the door. Neferteri goes on: "Whoever ordered you to attack my daughter did so over a petty argument. I am simply using my leverage to protect my daughter, and the citizens of the Sanbi Kingdom, against the likes of you." Arukia: "And I'm gonna protect myself from the likes of you." "That's unfortunate. Morika, please continue."
bf7f37100674.t: “Permaisuriku! Saya ada berita penting!” seseorang memanggil dari pintu. Neferteri meneruskan: “Sesiapa yang mengarahkanmu menyerang anakanda beta berbuat begitu kerana pertengkaran remeh. Beta cuma menggunakan kelebihan beta untuk melindungi anakanda beta, dan rakyat Kerajaan Sanbi, daripada orang-orang sepertimu.” Arukia: “Dan aku akan lindungi diri aku daripada orang-orang macam kau.” “Malang sekali. Morika, sila teruskan.”

bfc003618e06.en: "You think I only care about money? Honey. You really don't know me after all." Coema stands and spreads her arms. "Money is a tool for me to drink the tears of my enemies. Now, let's feast on Neferteri's tears." Ryo laughs. "Fair game. I'm in." Eori smirks. Magi doesn't look pleased. "Do you all think this is just a joke?" Coema understands where she's coming from, and acknowledges it: it's Neferteri playing games, but this time she's taken it too far, playing with matters she doesn't understand.
bfc003618e06.t: “Kau ingat aku cuma peduli pasal duit? Sayang. Kau memang tak kenal aku rupanya.” Coema berdiri dan mendepangkan tangan. “Duit ialah alat untuk aku minum air mata musuh-musuh aku. Sekarang, jom kita berpesta dengan air mata Neferteri.” Ryo ketawa. “Adil. Aku masuk.” Eori tersenyum sinis. Magi tidak nampak senang. “Korang semua ingat ni gurauan ke?” Coema faham dari mana datangnya kata-kata itu, dan mengakuinya: ini Neferteri bermain-main, tetapi kali ini dia sudah melampau, bermain dengan perkara yang tidak difahaminya.

c08a042d0f6d.en: They argue about Soul research being futile and dangerous. The teacher realizes what Eori is after. "You think you're the only one who wants to bring back a loved one? We all did! But the soul doesn't care!"
c08a042d0f6d.t: Mereka bertengkar tentang penyelidikan Jiwa yang sia-sia dan berbahaya. Guru itu sedar apa yang Eori kejar. “Kau ingat kau seorang saja yang nak hidupkan semula orang tersayang? Kami semua pernah! Tapi jiwa tak peduli!”

c1c3acc4df69.en: Magi, late morning, follows another wagon; no more Morika, just a random guy with a sword and a wagon full of things
c1c3acc4df69.t: Magi, lewat pagi, mengekori sebuah gerabak lain; tiada lagi Morika, hanya seorang lelaki biasa dengan pedang dan gerabak penuh barang

c1eb0cfae922.en: Ryo and Coema hug, Katsuki at his side (both in their normal appearance); a few Cruros around
c1eb0cfae922.t: Ryo dan Coema berpelukan, Katsuki di sisinya (kedua-duanya dalam rupa biasa); beberapa Cruro di sekeliling

c3ef81f595f7.en: Someone comes up behind Harry with a knife at his back. "Say anything, and I'll kill you." Harry defends himself, gets his clothes slashed and takes off running, but the attacker chases him down and slashes him. Harry tries to fight, but it's all in vain as a paralyzing poison takes over. He sees Eori's face, and wakes up.
c3ef81f595f7.t: Seseorang datang dari belakang Harry dengan pisau di belakangnya. “Cakap apa-apa, dan aku bunuh kau.” Harry mempertahankan diri, pakaiannya dikelar dan dia memecut lari, tetapi penyerang itu mengejarnya dan mengelarnya. Harry cuba melawan, tetapi semuanya sia-sia ketika racun yang melumpuhkan menguasainya. Dia nampak wajah Eori, dan terjaga.

c46cd2162445.en: He leads the pink adventurer to a table in the corner, looks around suspiciously, then speaks loudly: "I'm Desmond! How can I serve you today?" Then, quieter: "You're supposed to at least buy something, but don't tell anybody, or I'll be in trouble."
c46cd2162445.t: Dia membawa pengembara berbaju merah jambu itu ke sebuah meja di sudut, melihat sekeliling dengan curiga, kemudian bercakap kuat: “Saya Desmond! Boleh saya bantu hari ini?” Kemudian, lebih perlahan: “Kau sepatutnya sekurang-kurangnya beli sesuatu, tapi jangan beritahu sesiapa, nanti aku dapat masalah.”

c4ce65608f29.en: Eori drops her drink, rushes at him and tackles him to the ground. Harry, realizing who it is, puts his hand on her shoulder and tries to push her away while she forces herself on top of him for a kiss.
c4ce65608f29.t: Eori menjatuhkan minumannya, meluru ke arahnya dan menerkamnya ke tanah. Harry, sedar siapa itu, meletakkan tangan di bahunya dan cuba menolaknya sementara Eori memaksa dirinya ke atas Harry untuk mencium.

c53fc66986c9.en: Someone finds them and offers Arukia a Nari Refresher. She says no, but too late: it's given to her, and she heals. The baby monkey looks at her, not quite understanding, but when it smells her, it hugs her.
c53fc66986c9.t: Seseorang menemui mereka dan menawarkan Nari Refresher kepada Arukia. Dia kata tidak, tetapi terlambat: ia sudah diberikan kepadanya, dan dia sembuh. Bayi monyet itu memandangnya, tidak begitu faham, tetapi apabila ia menghidunya, ia memeluknya.

c55d92933002.en: Magi, Eori (in a fake body), Ryo and a few Cruros prepare to ambush the house
c55d92933002.t: Magi, Eori (dalam badan palsu), Ryo dan beberapa Cruro bersiap untuk menyerang hendap rumah itu

c5c83cebf2d8.en: Morika comes downstairs with food and forces it down Harry's throat. "You're nothing but a failed experiment. Now do as you're told, and serve your purpose."
c5c83cebf2d8.t: Morika turun ke bawah dengan makanan dan menyumbatnya ke kerongkong Harry. “Kau tak lebih daripada eksperimen yang gagal. Sekarang buat apa yang disuruh, dan tunaikan tujuan kau.”

c6bd169bd146.en: She asks where that one comes from. The vendor says he got it cheap from a boat coming from Sanbi. They sold it so cheap he doesn't even know how they made a profit.
c6bd169bd146.t: Dia bertanya dari mana datangnya yang itu. Penjual kata dia dapatnya murah daripada bot yang datang dari Sanbi. Mereka menjualnya begitu murah sehingga dia sendiri tidak tahu bagaimana mereka mendapat untung.

c6d471d577f4.en: Katsuki points at one face. "One—Harry." "Oh! You know the guy?" Ryo: "We know him. Yes. Can you tell me where you got it?" "I'll tell you if you buy one. I'll even do buy one, get one free." "What kind of info is this?" "My distributor, of course!" Ryo smiles. "{WIP-ryoDistributor}?" The guy looks surprised. "How the heck do you know him?" Ryo pulls out a couple of Pearls. "I've lived long enough."
c6d471d577f4.t: Katsuki menunjuk satu wajah. “Satu—Harry.” “Oh! Kau kenal lelaki ni?” Ryo: “Kami kenal dia. Ya. Boleh beritahu di mana kau dapat?” “Aku beritahu kalau kau beli satu. Aku malah bagi beli satu, percuma satu.” “Maklumat jenis apa ni?” “Pengedar aku, sudah tentu!” Ryo tersenyum. “{WIP-ryoDistributor}?” Lelaki itu nampak terkejut. “Macam mana kau kenal dia?” Ryo mengeluarkan beberapa Pearl. “Aku dah hidup cukup lama.”

c806214248ad.en: Magi wakes up against a wall; an old Cruro shows her a handwritten note: "You okay?" (her green bag isn't as full as before)
c806214248ad.t: Magi terjaga bersandar pada dinding; seorang Cruro tua menunjukkan nota tulisan tangan kepadanya: “Kau okey?” (beg hijaunya tidak sepenuh tadi)

c936d99ecdf8.en: Hanako: "You should leave before Yosuke comes back, or he'll punish Desmond." Magi does, grabbing a handful of Pearls, but as she walks out she hears Hanako's loud whisper: "Desmond's got a thing for girly adventurers!" Magi acts as if she didn't hear, but embarrassment tickles her as she walks out.
c936d99ecdf8.t: Hanako: “Baik kau pergi sebelum Yosuke balik, nanti dia hukum Desmond.” Magi beredar, mengambil segenggam Pearl, tetapi ketika dia keluar dia mendengar bisikan kuat Hanako: “Desmond memang suka pengembara feminin!” Magi berlagak seolah-olah tidak mendengar, tetapi rasa malu menggeletek dirinya ketika dia keluar.

c95d6b9a931d.en: "Miss pink adventurer!" Mimi flies over to Magi and asks loudly: "Have you seen Desmond?" Magi feels strange as the restaurant workers and patrons turn their attention to her. "I haven't seen him since yesterday."
c95d6b9a931d.t: “Cik pengembara merah jambu!” Mimi terbang ke arah Magi dan bertanya kuat: “Ada nampak Desmond?” Magi rasa pelik ketika pekerja dan pelanggan restoran mengalihkan perhatian kepadanya. “Aku tak nampak dia sejak semalam.”

ca7ce34e356b.en: Eiri: "But—but I don't want to put Arukia in harm's way!" "Daughter. Get your shit together. She needs to pay for her actions, even if they were justified by her own logic."
ca7ce34e356b.t: Eiri: “Tapi—tapi aku tak nak letak Arukia dalam bahaya!” “Anak. Sedarlah. Dia perlu bayar untuk tindakannya, walaupun ia wajar mengikut logiknya sendiri.”

caabe3c28c8c.en: Magi realizes Harry is dying, so he won't be taking off again. She eases her bow, and dips Harry's badge in the pool of his own blood.
caabe3c28c8c.t: Magi sedar Harry sedang nazak, jadi dia tidak akan lari lagi. Dia melonggarkan busurnya, dan mencelup lencana Harry ke dalam takungan darahnya sendiri.

cab5a3578781.en: She'll appear more, to instigate Eori and Eiri onto a "good" path… (still open).
cab5a3578781.t: Dia akan muncul lebih kerap, untuk menghasut Eori dan Eiri ke jalan yang “baik”… (masih terbuka).

cda79f169a0d.en: She notices the note. Pink Adventurer, I told you that you could borrow Hanako's clothes. I went to an atelier to get my uniform patched up. Here's a proper thank you. There's a handful of Pearls, and the food. Her starving stomach demands she swallow it whole; she slurps it up in a hurry, but it tastes kind of salty, and some of the spices are off.
cda79f169a0d.t: Dia perasan nota itu. Pengembara Merah Jambu, aku dah cakap kau boleh pinjam baju Hanako. Aku pergi ke atelier untuk tampal pakaian seragam aku. Ini tanda terima kasih yang sewajarnya. Ada segenggam Pearl, dan makanan itu. Perutnya yang kelaparan menuntutnya menelan semuanya; dia menghirupnya tergesa-gesa, tetapi rasanya agak masin, dan sesetengah rempahnya tak kena.

ce2fead793d0.en: Harry notices Magi in the background, but doesn't think much of it.
ce2fead793d0.t: Harry perasan Magi di belakang, tetapi tidak terlalu memikirkannya.

ceda51afa30a.en: Magi anxiously waits while the Embassy clerk counts the Fost stones. She watches his hand move each small stone from one pile to the other, her eyes following the repetitive motion, growing wearier with each one. She tries not to blink at all costs, but her eyelids fight her tooth and nail. She gives in to one quick blink.
ceda51afa30a.t: Magi menunggu dengan cemas sementara kerani Kedutaan mengira Fost stone. Dia memerhati tangan kerani itu memindahkan setiap batu kecil dari satu longgok ke longgok lain, matanya mengikut gerakan berulang itu, semakin letih dengan setiap satu. Dia cuba tidak berkelip walau apa pun, tetapi kelopak matanya melawan habis-habisan. Dia mengalah untuk satu kelipan pantas.

cfc4f5242e45.en: Yosuke grills her: "What are you doing to his uniform? He hasn't paid it off yet!" Magi, who knows a fair bit about how this works, carefully finishes pulling out the arrow. "I'm sorry, but I thought he was Harry from Sanbi." "He's Desmond from Rebula! Did you even think to ask? Look at him! You ruined the uniform!" "I'm sorry about the arrow, but Princess Eori was the one who kicked him!" "So they weren't lying when they told me Princess Eori tackled Desmond to the ground." Magi, digging through her backpack: "I saw it too."
cfc4f5242e45.t: Yosuke memarahinya: “Apa kau buat pada pakaian seragam dia? Dia belum habis bayar lagi!” Magi, yang tahu agak banyak tentang hal ini, dengan berhati-hati menghabiskan mencabut anak panah itu. “Maaf, tapi saya ingat dia Harry dari Sanbi.” “Dia Desmond dari Rebula! Kau ada terfikir nak tanya? Tengok dia! Kau rosakkan pakaian seragam!” “Saya minta maaf pasal anak panah, tapi Puteri Eori yang tendang dia!” “Jadi mereka tak tipu bila beritahu aku Puteri Eori terkam Desmond ke tanah.” Magi, menyelongkar beg galasnya: “Saya nampak juga.”

d08e64c9e6de.en: The Cruro smells the blood. Arukia is afraid it'll know who she truly is, but it doesn't: this Cruro has lived here its entire life. The person: "Were you trying to look like its first owner?" Arukia: "Yeah. That." The person laughs out loud. "That's pretty stupid. They recognize you by your smell. You'd need a full-body nari to trick them. Anyway, let's have supper, and you two can bathe before heading home."
d08e64c9e6de.t: Cruro itu menghidu darah. Arukia takut ia akan tahu siapa dirinya sebenarnya, tetapi tidak: Cruro ini tinggal di sini seumur hidupnya. Orang itu: “Kau cuba nak nampak macam tuan pertama dia ke?” Arukia: “Ya. Macam tu la.” Orang itu ketawa kuat. “Bodoh betul. Mereka kenal kau melalui bau. Kau perlukan nari seluruh badan untuk menipu mereka. Apa-apa pun, jom makan malam, dan korang berdua boleh mandi sebelum balik.”

d225f8560753.en: They notice Harry's face among the gels. Eori has an altercation with the vendor and gets the info, and they hear the same story: cheap gels from Sanbi. Magi heals the guy back up, while Eori spits on him and walks away.
d225f8560753.t: Mereka perasan wajah Harry di antara gel-gel itu. Eori bertengkar dengan penjual dan mendapat maklumat, dan mereka mendengar cerita yang sama: gel murah dari Sanbi. Magi menyembuhkan lelaki itu semula, sementara Eori meludahnya dan beredar.

d257fa4c350f.en: Magi realizes Harry gave most of his money away, which left him almost nothing to flee with. They ask her to find him; she tells them to post a search quest, and leaves. "But he doesn't have a badge!"
d257fa4c350f.t: Magi sedar Harry memberikan kebanyakan wangnya, yang meninggalkannya hampir tiada apa-apa untuk melarikan diri. Mereka memintanya mencari Harry; dia menyuruh mereka meletakkan misi pencarian, dan beredar. “Tapi dia tak ada lencana!”

d39557f75e57.en: Eiri cries, Sora consoles her; Arukia, eyes watering, holds the Bruntos
d39557f75e57.t: Eiri menangis, Sora memujuknya; Arukia, mata berair, memeluk Bruntos

d47b251a3b3c.en: Magi sees how much he's cowering. She looks at where she's hidden his badge, and lowers her bow with a defeated expression. "An older guy in the same uniform as you gave me the key to the restaurant and asked me to take you there." Harry looks at his uniform and touches it in disbelief. "Oh no. He's gonna punish me!" Magi feels like an asshole. "I'm sorry about the arrow, but Princess Eori did most of it."
d47b251a3b3c.t: Magi nampak betapa dia meringkuk. Dia memandang tempat dia menyembunyikan lencana Harry, dan menurunkan busurnya dengan wajah kalah. “Seorang lelaki tua berpakaian seragam sama macam kau bagi aku kunci restoran dan suruh aku bawa kau ke sana.” Harry memandang pakaian seragamnya dan menyentuhnya tidak percaya. “Oh tidak. Dia akan hukum aku!” Magi rasa macam bangsat. “Aku minta maaf pasal anak panah, tapi Puteri Eori yang buat kebanyakannya.”

d5a33b7714cf.en: As they follow, Coema: "So Eori hired you, but do you have ulterior motives too?" Magi thinks of her vanished father, then glances at Coema, a mature woman who has likely lived through a whole lot. "My father disappeared, just like Harry." She furrows her brow. A conspiracy that, I now think, some rich piece of shit was just laughing off.
d5a33b7714cf.t: Sambil mengekori, Coema: “Jadi Eori upah kau, tapi kau ada motif lain juga?” Magi teringat ayahnya yang hilang, kemudian mengerling Coema, seorang wanita matang yang mungkin sudah melalui banyak perkara. “Ayah aku hilang, sama macam Harry.” Dia mengerutkan dahi. Satu konspirasi yang, aku rasa sekarang, ada orang kaya taik sedang mentertawakannya.

d6c71585b85b.en: The body isn't Arukia. It's a decoy: an already soul-dead corpse made up as Arukia with nari gel, so no revival could ever work. Blinded by anger, Eori never uses a Nari Refresher on it, so she doesn't find out (the real Arukia is alive, with Neferteri; see Book 16). Later, Eori realizes she didn't even do that simple check, and grows to regret her emotional fits.
d6c71585b85b.t: Mayat itu bukan Arukia. Ia umpan: mayat yang sudah mati jiwanya disolek sebagai Arukia dengan nari gel, jadi tiada penghidupan semula yang boleh berjaya. Dibutakan oleh kemarahan, Eori tidak pernah menggunakan Nari Refresher padanya, jadi dia tidak dapat tahu (Arukia yang sebenar masih hidup, bersama Neferteri; lihat Buku 16). Kemudian, Eori sedar dia tidak pun membuat pemeriksaan semudah itu, dan mula menyesali ledakan emosinya.

d71961c896ed.en: Magi nocks another arrow, looks at Eori again, and realizes that's the princess of Sanbi. Wait—the duel was for Maiara's hand—what's going on here?
d71961c896ed.t: Magi memasang satu lagi anak panah, memandang Eori lagi, dan sedar itu puteri Sanbi. Kejap—pertarungan tu untuk meminang Maiara—apa sebenarnya berlaku ni?

de8fd66e491c.en: She acts as if she fears for her life. "Please don't hurt me! I give up! I'll do as the Red Winga contract says." Bandit: "You had your chance. Now you're gonna be used and abused by our worst clientele."
de8fd66e491c.t: Dia berlakon seolah-olah takut akan nyawanya. “Tolong jangan sakiti aku! Aku menyerah! Aku akan ikut apa kontrak Red Winga kata.” Penyamun: “Kau dah ada peluang kau. Sekarang kau akan diguna dan didera oleh pelanggan kami yang paling teruk.”

e00fb1e3fb5d.en: She starts to think this was all a bad idea. She holds her baby tight as the boat makes landfall, and walks around a bit. Two Cruros sniff close to her, then come over and flip through their books for something pre-written: "We've been looking out for you. Coema wants to talk to you." Arukia freezes for a second, then goes along.
e00fb1e3fb5d.t: Dia mula rasa ini semua idea yang buruk. Dia memeluk bayinya erat ketika bot berlabuh, dan berjalan-jalan sedikit. Dua Cruro menghidu dekat dengannya, kemudian datang dan menyelak buku mereka mencari sesuatu yang sudah ditulis: “Kami dah tunggu kau. Coema nak bercakap dengan kau.” Arukia kaku seketika, kemudian ikut sama.

e026fe801218.en: A man shouting advertisements in the background suddenly calls out, "Arukia, we miss you!", and moves on. A wave of emotions hits Arukia as she remembers how life used to be. She cries, and the baby Bruntos hugs her. She hugs it back.
e026fe801218.t: Seorang lelaki yang melaung iklan di belakang tiba-tiba memanggil, “Arukia, kami rindukan kau!”, dan berlalu. Gelombang emosi melanda Arukia ketika dia teringat bagaimana hidupnya dahulu. Dia menangis, dan bayi Bruntos itu memeluknya. Dia memeluknya kembali.

e076cda6d933.en: Ryo: "By the way, can I ask how Princess Eori got involved in this?" Coema: "I gave her the means to free herself, and I plan to do the same for Harry." Magi raises her hand. "But why?" Ryo perks up his ears. "I don't see how you're making money off this either."
e076cda6d933.t: Ryo: “By the way, boleh aku tanya macam mana Puteri Eori terlibat dalam hal ni?” Coema: “Aku beri dia cara untuk membebaskan diri, dan aku bercadang buat yang sama untuk Harry.” Magi mengangkat tangan. “Tapi kenapa?” Ryo memasang telinga. “Aku pun tak nampak macam mana kau buat duit daripada ni.”

e171c03b53f1.en: Source: Legacy/Behind The Scenes/Light Novel/Arc #4 - Fishy Conspiracy.md
e171c03b53f1.t: Sumber: Legacy/Behind The Scenes/Light Novel/Arc #4 - Fishy Conspiracy.md

e194d5797df7.en: Hanako comes over to Mimi. "Leave her be. We're at work right now." Mimi, crying: "But Desmond disappeared! I want Desmond back!" Yosuke appears from the kitchen. "What's going on? Mimi! Don't make a scene! Go to your room!" Hanako: "If you find him, let us know. Mimi, c'mon." Mimi hugs Hanako as they head upstairs.
e194d5797df7.t: Hanako mendekati Mimi. “Biarkan dia. Kita tengah kerja sekarang.” Mimi, menangis: “Tapi Desmond hilang! Aku nak Desmond balik!” Yosuke muncul dari dapur. “Apa yang berlaku? Mimi! Jangan buat kecoh! Pergi ke bilik kau!” Hanako: “Kalau kau jumpa dia, beritahu kami. Mimi, jom.” Mimi memeluk Hanako ketika mereka naik ke atas.

e322b6a004b2.en: Ryo: "I knew Queen Neferteri liked to steer the conversation her way, but all of this is news to me." Eori: "Try living under her, then." "I'll pass—by the way, if you don't mind me asking, what will you do if Harry doesn't want to come with you?"
e322b6a004b2.t: Ryo: “Aku tahu Permaisuri Neferteri suka mengemudi perbualan ikut cara dia, tapi semua ni berita baru bagi aku.” Eori: “Cubalah hidup di bawah dia.” “Tak apalah—by the way, kalau kau tak kisah aku tanya, apa kau akan buat kalau Harry tak nak ikut kau?”

e4dace524bd4.en: Laura (the Madam) and Emelia talk; Laura's face isn't shown
e4dace524bd4.t: Laura (Madam) dan Emelia berbincang; wajah Laura tidak ditunjukkan

e5108d2eaa47.en: The assistant looks turned on by Katsumi, who teases her, then looks at Ryo. "Are you asking me for permission? I told you, it's your place, it's your life. Have fun!" Katsumi fakes a kiss and plays with her some more, rubs her butt on the assistant, and they kiss.
e5108d2eaa47.t: Pembantu itu nampak terangsang dengan Katsumi, yang mengusiknya, kemudian memandang Ryo. “Kau minta kebenaran aku ke? Aku dah cakap, ini tempat kau, ini hidup kau. Berseronoklah!” Katsumi berpura-pura mencium dan bermain dengannya lagi, menggesel punggungnya pada pembantu itu, dan mereka berciuman.

e546b63693e2.en: Magi has to decide: stay, or go back and raise the alarm. She takes off.
e546b63693e2.t: Magi perlu memutuskan: tinggal, atau kembali dan memberi amaran. Dia berlepas.

e55f05d2b90d.en: Magi in front of Yosuke's restaurant; Harry smiles at her
e55f05d2b90d.t: Magi di depan restoran Yosuke; Harry tersenyum kepadanya

e77bebb6609e.en: Ryo and the sisters stand in front of a rundown old resort with an assistant
e77bebb6609e.t: Ryo dan dua beradik itu berdiri di depan sebuah resort lama yang usang bersama seorang pembantu

e84c1a5cc66f.en: Magi looks at Eori. She flies just as well as I do. Didn't expect that from a princess. Morika stops at a rundown building and takes the body inside. Eori: "Let's go!" Coema: "Hold! This is too easy!"
e84c1a5cc66f.t: Magi memandang Eori. Dia terbang sama baik macam aku. Tak sangka daripada seorang puteri. Morika berhenti di sebuah bangunan usang dan membawa mayat itu masuk. Eori: “Jom!” Coema: “Tunggu! Ini terlalu mudah!”

e88fb955ceba.en: Magi holds Harry's badge: it doesn't light up. Eori's mouth hangs open; Harry looks at his badge and says nothing
e88fb955ceba.t: Magi memegang lencana Harry: ia tidak menyala. Mulut Eori ternganga; Harry memandang lencananya dan tidak berkata apa-apa

e8d590ac6922.en: Arukia and her baby Bruntos walk down a mountain in the rain
e8d590ac6922.t: Arukia dan bayi Bruntosnya menuruni gunung dalam hujan

e8d8f046956a.en: Eori crumples the letter in anger. "I'm not her little bitch! I'm here because I want to get Harry back!" She ignores it, reads Neferteri's letter, throws that one away too, and sinks into the dumps. She wants to blow up the room and kill everyone, but she can't, or she'll be punished and humiliated again.
e8d8f046956a.t: Eori merenyukkan surat itu dengan marah. “Aku bukan jalang kecil dia! Aku di sini sebab aku nak dapatkan Harry balik!” Dia mengabaikannya, membaca surat Neferteri, membuang yang itu juga, dan tenggelam dalam kemurungan. Dia mahu meletupkan bilik itu dan membunuh semua orang, tetapi dia tidak boleh, atau dia akan dihukum dan dimalukan lagi.

e9c97f416476.en: Magi wakes up in Harry's bed near sunset; food to the side under glass, plus a note
e9c97f416476.t: Magi terjaga di katil Harry menjelang senja; makanan di tepi di bawah tudung kaca, serta sekeping nota

ea3207947630.en: Ryo: Maybe she's pregnant after all. It would explain puking her guts out at dawn, then eating like a Bagarisa the rest of the day. "Not to dredge up your past, but have you ever gotten pregnant?" Katsuki pauses for a second. "One. Nari. Two. Gel." (Ryo is the father.) "Got it. The Red Winga kept giving you nari gel to keep that from happening. Well, no more alcohol for you." He takes away her glass, raising a finger to the sky.
ea3207947630.t: Ryo: Mungkin dia memang mengandung. Itu akan menjelaskan dia muntah teruk waktu subuh, kemudian makan macam Bagarisa sepanjang hari. “Bukan nak ungkit masa lalu kau, tapi kau pernah mengandung?” Katsuki berhenti sejenak. “Satu. Nari. Dua. Gel.” (Ryo bapanya.) “Faham. Red Winga terus bagi kau nari gel untuk elak benda tu berlaku. Yalah, tak ada lagi arak untuk kau.” Dia mengambil gelasnya, mengangkat jari ke langit.

f26c4848c871.en: {WIP-ryoDistributor} and Ryo meet, and Ryo introduces his business partner. {WIP-ryoDistributor} explains the gels came from the Sanbi Kingdom: some random guy is mass-producing them and sending them to the four corners of the world.
f26c4848c871.t: {WIP-ryoDistributor} dan Ryo bertemu, dan Ryo memperkenalkan rakan niaganya. {WIP-ryoDistributor} menerangkan gel-gel itu datang dari Kerajaan Sanbi: seorang lelaki entah siapa mengeluarkannya secara besar-besaran dan menghantarnya ke empat penjuru dunia.

f2951c1db561.en: Magi, covered in dirt, passes Yosuke's restaurant with whatever she's carrying
f2951c1db561.t: Magi, berlumuran tanah, melintasi restoran Yosuke dengan apa saja yang dibawanya

f29ac4822d93.en: Coema; Arukia, holding her baby Bruntos tight; four Cruros nearby
f29ac4822d93.t: Coema; Arukia, memeluk bayi Bruntosnya erat; empat Cruro berdekatan

f37802c6cc76.en: Ryo: "Do you think they're turning a profit?" {WIP-ryoDistributor}: "If they use Cruro labor and didn't pay this guy, then maybe a Pearl per nari gel? My prices here are shipping plus 25%, and it's barely selling." "What's the price of knowing who sold to you?" {WIP-ryoDistributor} pulls a contract from his table. "It's on the house. Looks can be deceiving, but Lick looked like he had zero experience trading. He even looked like he didn't care whether he turned a profit."
f37802c6cc76.t: Ryo: “Kau rasa mereka dapat untung?” {WIP-ryoDistributor}: “Kalau mereka guna tenaga kerja Cruro dan tak bayar lelaki ni, mungkin satu Pearl untuk setiap nari gel? Harga aku di sini kos penghantaran tambah 25%, dan hampir tak laku.” “Berapa harga untuk tahu siapa yang jual kepada kau?” {WIP-ryoDistributor} menarik sebuah kontrak dari mejanya. “Percuma. Rupa boleh menipu, tapi Lick nampak macam langsung tak ada pengalaman berdagang. Dia malah nampak macam tak peduli sama ada dia dapat untung.”

f51d681cd311.en: Harry in an alley, slumped against the wall in a growing pool of blood, teary-eyed, puking blood; Eori and Magi, side by side, watch him cower in fear
f51d681cd311.t: Harry di lorong, tersandar ke dinding dalam takungan darah yang semakin besar, berlinang air mata, muntah darah; Eori dan Magi, bersebelahan, memerhatinya meringkuk ketakutan

f53bfc5c6306.en: The assistant runs out from the back with a pile of papers. "WAIIT! Can you also hand these out to the boards on your way?" Ryo looks them over. "Damn. Just as hot as in real life. Good job!" The assistant looks happy.
f53bfc5c6306.t: Pembantu berlari keluar dari belakang dengan setimbun kertas. “TUNGGUUU! Boleh tolong edarkan ni ke papan-papan dalam perjalanan?” Ryo membeleknya. “Celaka. Sama seksi macam dalam realiti. Kerja bagus!” Pembantu itu nampak gembira.

f597f6baf5ec.en: Eori, impatient, flips Coema off with one hand and eats a Nari Refresher with the other; Magi holds her badge; a few more Cruros keep them apart from everyone
f597f6baf5ec.t: Eori, tidak sabar, menunjuk jari tengah kepada Coema dengan sebelah tangan dan makan Nari Refresher dengan tangan yang lagi satu; Magi memegang lencananya; beberapa lagi Cruro memisahkan mereka daripada semua orang

f67d8b27695f.en: The guy tries to sell them nari gel. Katsuki realizes one of the faces is Harry, and chokes on her food. Ryo is about to get up when she raises her hand; after a few more coughs, she seems back to normal. The guy says he has a new nari gel that prevents that from happening. Ryo: "But she can't. She's pregnant."
f67d8b27695f.t: Lelaki itu cuba menjual nari gel kepada mereka. Katsuki sedar salah satu wajah itu Harry, dan tercekik makanannya. Ryo hendak bangun apabila dia mengangkat tangan; selepas beberapa kali batuk, dia nampak kembali normal. Lelaki itu kata dia ada nari gel baharu yang menghalang perkara itu berlaku. Ryo: “Tapi dia tak boleh. Dia mengandung.”

f78cc162aea6.en: Coema: "And who might you be?" Ryo: "My lovely assistant, Katsuki." Katsuki doesn't speak. Coema: "Did a Cruro eat your tongue?" Katsuki, embarrassed: "One—no." "One?" Ryo: "It's how she gets the words out. Give it a few minutes and you'll understand what she means. By the way, looks like the Newland expedition turned out pretty rewarding."
f78cc162aea6.t: Coema: “Dan siapa pula kau?” Ryo: “Pembantu aku yang menawan, Katsuki.” Katsuki tidak bercakap. Coema: “Cruro makan lidah kau ke?” Katsuki, malu: “Satu—tak.” “Satu?” Ryo: “Itu caranya dia keluarkan kata-kata. Beri beberapa minit dan kau akan faham maksud dia. By the way, nampaknya ekspedisi Newland tu sangat menguntungkan.”

f7a52b224432.en: Arukia arrives in Sanbi by boat, her heart struggling
f7a52b224432.t: Arukia tiba di Sanbi dengan bot, hatinya bergelut

f7b750de5ab1.en: Ryo says he's going to Blood by way of Forway. Katsumi teases the adventurers that she'll give them special treatment if they take good care of her sister and Ryo.
f7b750de5ab1.t: Ryo kata dia akan ke Blood melalui Forway. Katsumi mengusik para pengembara bahawa dia akan beri mereka layanan istimewa jika mereka menjaga adiknya dan Ryo dengan baik.

f7c2bb41398d.en: A Cruro finds them after the landslide
f7c2bb41398d.t: Seorang Cruro menemui mereka selepas tanah runtuh

f7ee4d6a68a2.en: Neferteri sighs and sits down. "I am the Queen of Sanbi. I protect my people. Harry is not one of us. You're not one of us." "What are you saying?" "This failed experiment was supposed to be a shining example of a warrior, to help us defend against Forway, and the likes of you."
f7ee4d6a68a2.t: Neferteri mengeluh dan duduk. “Beta Permaisuri Sanbi. Beta melindungi rakyat beta. Harry bukan salah seorang daripada kami. Kau bukan salah seorang daripada kami.” “Apa maksud kau?” “Eksperimen yang gagal ini sepatutnya menjadi contoh pahlawan yang cemerlang, untuk membantu kami bertahan menentang Forway, dan orang-orang sepertimu.”

f984aa2abf8a.en: The clerk, {WIP-embassyClerk}: "I looked at your contract history. You've never done one of these?" Magi: "Why were you investigating me? I didn't do anything wrong." "Well, you look like a shambles, and you're taking all the boring quests." Magi doesn't look pleased. "I have my reasons. Just give me the contract."
f984aa2abf8a.t: Kerani itu, {WIP-embassyClerk}: “Saya tengok sejarah kontrak kamu. Kamu tak pernah buat yang macam ni?” Magi: “Kenapa mak cik siasat saya? Saya tak buat salah apa-apa.” “Yalah, kamu nampak serabai, dan kamu ambil semua misi yang membosankan.” Magi tidak nampak senang. “Saya ada sebab sendiri. Bagi saja kontrak tu.”

f9f572f70359.en: Harry feels the arrow is about to fly. He cowers, hands up, protecting his face. "I'm sorry! I'm sorry!—HARRY! My name is Harry!" He says the name he's been avoiding for so long. It sounds strange, almost foreign, but somehow a relief, even with a pointy arrow ready to tear his flesh. "Tell Dalila and everyone I'm sorry."
f9f572f70359.t: Harry rasa anak panah itu akan dilepaskan. Dia meringkuk, tangan diangkat, melindungi mukanya. “Maaf! Maaf!—HARRY! Nama aku Harry!” Dia menyebut nama yang sudah begitu lama dielakkannya. Ia terdengar pelik, hampir asing, tetapi entah bagaimana melegakan, walaupun dengan anak panah tajam bersedia mengoyak dagingnya. “Beritahu Dalila dan semua orang aku minta maaf.”

fe524be2c28f.en: Neferteri has Morika use Harry's blood to make nari gel of his face and spread it to the four corners of the world. "That way, Eori will realize we have Harry, and she'll come back to me."
fe524be2c28f.t: Neferteri menyuruh Morika menggunakan darah Harry untuk membuat nari gel wajahnya dan menyebarkannya ke empat penjuru dunia. “Dengan cara itu, Eori akan sedar kita ada Harry, dan dia akan kembali kepada beta.”

feab17153855.en: Eori goes from stunned to angry. She kicks Harry in the ribs, breaking them. "You fucking piece of shit! How dare you look like him!" A gurgled scream escapes Harry as his weakened arm barely blocks the kicks. Magi draws on Eori. "STOP!" "DON'T FUCK WITH ME!" Eori, blood spattered on her clothes, points and storms toward Magi.
feab17153855.t: Eori berubah daripada terkejut kepada marah. Dia menendang rusuk Harry, mematahkannya. “Kau taik celaka! Berani kau rupa macam dia!” Jeritan berdeguk terlepas daripada Harry ketika lengannya yang lemah hampir tidak dapat menahan tendangan. Magi menghala busur kepada Eori. “BERHENTI!” “JANGAN MAIN-MAIN DENGAN AKU!” Eori, darah terpercik di pakaiannya, menuding dan meluru ke arah Magi.
